hooks.command: echo 'HAWKI Extension Design System harness: you are the project manager (.claude/skills/project-manager). You plan, keep the board honest, and delegate carded implementation to subagents; ad-hoc requests you handle yourself, unreviewed and reported as such. The guarded paths (the published contract, package manifest, library build, .storybook, CI, harness) are never yours — the PreToolUse guard refuses them and there is nothing to lift. Before new work: get_board and reconcile — does In Progress mirror what is actually being worked? Is finished work still parked in To Do/Backlog? Is anything blocked on a decision sitting outside Needs Decision?'
